name: fraudshield-ai
description: FraudShield AI — browser-local credit card fraud detection with ONNX Runtime Web

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node --input-type=module -e "import {readdirSync,rmSync,statSync} from 'fs'; for (const f of readdirSync('dist/assets')) { const p='dist/assets/'+f; if (/^ort-.*\.wasm$/.test(f)) { console.log('dropping oversized', p, Math.round(statSync(p).size/1048576)+'MiB'); rmSync(p); } }"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name fraudshield-ai
